# BASSLINE BL23 — third-party art credits

Every third-party asset shipped with the mansion is **CC0 1.0 (public domain)**: no attribution is legally required, it is listed here as good practice and for provenance.
Source: Poly Haven (https://polyhaven.com, licence https://polyhaven.com/license). Downloaded over HTTPS from the official API (https://api.polyhaven.com / https://dl.polyhaven.org), glTF + 1k textures, assets only.

Converted meshes live in `Resources/Mansion/Models/<id>.asset` (built by `Editor/Mansion/MansionModelConverter`), their textures in `Art/Mansion/Models/<id>/`. Tiling PBR textures live in `Resources/Mansion/Tex/`.
